name: Nakanoshima Tae
source: Tae is Jun’s classmate, childhood friend, and neighbor. She’s a trombone player and is the vice-head of the brass band. She’s a friendly and cheery girl and gets along well with everyone. Tae wakes Jun up every morning and also makes him lunch since she’s a great cook. She cares about Jun a lot, and she has had feelings for him forever. She and Jun talk to each other from their windows at night.
